code.purpose: scope chip / 数据 mono，绝不当装饰。

shadows.purpose: 品牌标衬底的门禁靛蓝柔影。

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: 单一主行动按钮：反色瓷面钮，每状态全卡仅一枚。
components.css: .ds-cta-primary { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: canvastext; color: canvas; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cta-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, canvastext 84%, canvas); } .ds-cta-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #324DE2 70%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cta-primary:disabled { opacity: .6; }

components.name: Method Button
components.description: 双方法等分次级钮：透明底描边，hover 混底，窄屏竖排满宽。
components.css: .ds-method { flex: 1; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent); background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-method:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 6%, transparent); } .ds-method:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #324DE2 70%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: 状态徽章 pill：点色表意 ok/wait/err，wait 点呼吸。
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 4%, transparent); } .ds-badge-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-badge-dot--ok { background: #2da44e; } .ds-badge-dot--wait { background: #d29922; animation: ds-breathe 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-badge-dot--err { background: #d1242f; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 50% { opacity: .35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-badge-dot--wait { animation: none; } }

components.name: Mono Chip
components.description: scope 权限 chip：mono 小字，缺失权限变红框红字。
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; padding: 1px 8px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 16%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 5%, transparent); } .ds-chip--miss { color: color-mix(in srgb, #d1242f 85%, currentColor); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #d1242f 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, #d1242f 9%, canvas); }

components.name: Gate Card
components.description: 瓷面玻璃卡：96% canvas 釉面 + blur + 深影 + gate-in 入场。
components.html:
GitHub 仓库授权

先安装 gh CLI，再连接 GitHub
components.css: .ds-gate-card { padding: 22px 24px 18px; border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, canvas 96%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 32px 64px -24px rgb(0 0 0/.4), 0 4px 16px rgb(0 0 0/.14); animation: ds-gate-in 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-gate-card b { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.01em; } @keyframes ds-gate-in { from { transform: translateY(8px); opacity: .6; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-gate-card { animation: none; } }

components.name: Mono Input
components.description: 令牌输入框：mono、4% 混底、靛蓝 focus ring。
components.css: .ds-mono-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 18%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 4%, canvas); color: inherit; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-mono-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 40%, transparent); } .ds-mono-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #324DE2 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Aux Text Link
components.description: 辅助文字按钮：右对齐低阶字，hover 归位；危险变体红混字。
components.html: <button class="ds-aux">重新校验</button> <button class="ds-aux ds-aux--danger">删除凭证</button>
components.css: .ds-aux { border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 62%, transparent); } .ds-aux:hover { color: inherit; background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 6%, transparent); } .ds-aux:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #324DE2 60%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-aux--danger { color: color-mix(in srgb, #d1242f 78%, currentColor); }

narrative.overview: 面板如瓷：半透 canvas 釉面（96% 混透明）+ backdrop-filter 玻璃底 + 深影托起，自成温润体感；釉色不私有——颜色一律走宿主系统关键字 canvas / canvastext 经 color-mix() 派生，宿主换主题即整器换釉。门禁靛蓝 #324DE2 是唯一的印款色，只出现在品牌标、品牌衬底与 focus ring 上，占比极低，稀缺即识别。工作台是 Operate 模式界面：可扫读性、一致性、平台惯例优先于表达；登录门禁面板是唯一的品牌表达场，进入工作台后回归朴素 Operate 语言，但材质语言全线贯通。
keyCharacteristics: 主题自适应釉面：无任何硬编码浅色底，主题由宿主切换
每个状态只有一个主 CTA（单一主行动纪律）
状态语义三点色：ok 绿 / wait·warn 琥珀（呼吸）/ err 红
玻璃瓷面 + 深影浮起的混合深度语言
动效只有一次作者化时刻（gate-in 220ms），reduced-motion 全关

rules.name: The Host-Theme Rule
rules.body: 禁止硬编码任何浅色底值——主题由宿主切换，写死底色必在另一主题翻车。语义色固定值只允许出现在点、片段、横幅的小面积上；文字级语义色必须 color-mix 85% 混入前景。

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: 主 CTA 是唯一反色元素（canvastext 底 + canvas 字，hover 混 84%）；一屏之内反色只出现一次。

rules.name: The Inherited Voice Rule
rules.body: 不声明 font-family（mono 除外）——字体是宿主的，插件只定尺寸与字重。

dos: Do 全部 UI 文案走 zh-CN / en 双字典（i18n + locale-parity 守护）；cred.* 键在组件内静态字面量引用。
Do 错误文案同时命名问题与恢复动作；限流文案必须声明「不影响凭据有效性，无需重新授权」。
Do 修改任何 UI 前先 npm run build + 跑 i18n/locale-parity 守护。
Do 大标题用产品金句「连接代码库，让 Agent 自主交付」；品牌区只留大标题。
donts: Don't 硬编码浅色底值（The Host-Theme Rule）。
Don't 卡片内嵌子卡；门禁行内嵌动作按钮。
Don't 动态拼接 i18n 键名（动态前缀白名单守护会红）。
Don't 一个状态出现两个主 CTA；mono 字体用于非代码/数据内容。
Don't 忘记 reduced-motion 降级。
